title: disperma nudantherum
intro: Disperma nudantherum, commonly known as "Sudachi", is a type of plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. Research has shown that Sudachi exhibits various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, which can aid in the treatment of infections and skin conditions. Sudachi's bioactive constituents include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
